name: Arcturus Perimeter Drone (Autonomous Patrol)
description: A medium-sized autonomous drone designed for continuous perimeter patrol of corporate facilities, industrial zones, and secured districts. Larger than the Axiom Sentinel and armed with lethal options, the Perimeter Drone operates in pairs on fixed routes with AI-directed deviation for anomaly investigation. They carry enough ordnance to engage a vehicle and enough sensors to read a name badge from 500 meters. The humming of Perimeter Drones along corporate borders is the sound of a line you are not supposed to cross.
propulsion: Ducted fan VTOL, high-endurance battery with solar supplement
autonomy: Fully autonomous, paired AI coordination, lethal authority rules of engagement
armament: Chin-mounted flechette cannon, stun projector, target designator for supporting assets.
common_usage: Facility perimeter security, exclusion zone enforcement, border patrol, threat engagement.
story_hooks: Perimeter Drones along a corporate border start engaging targets on the corporate side — their IFF system has been compromised
A pair of Perimeter Drones deviate from their route to investigate something in the Underworld access tunnel and don't come back
